title: Explicit coefficient transport of raw unit classes
statement: For a scheme morphism f:X→S, degree q, etale chart U and structural raw class z [def-pc-scheme,def-weil-pbc-coherent-higher-image-classes], define its coherent raw transport by the canonical raw coefficient map of the inverse explicit unit coefficient isomorphism [new-unit-structure-coefficient-iso,def-weil-pbc-raw-restricted-normalization-data]. This is postcomposition of the represented derived morphism, with no choice of a raw class.

def unitCoherentRawClass {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (q : ℕ) (U : S.Etale)
    (z : (Etale.abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf f q X.etaleAdditiveSheaf).obj (op U)) :
    (Etale.abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf f q
      (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))).obj (op U)
